response.outreach_email:
Subject: Agency-to-brand path, coffee chat?

Hi Hannah,

My classmate introduced us, and I was excited to learn about your move from a creative agency to Bright Meadow Foods as an Associate Brand Manager. I'm an MBA candidate (Class of 2028). Before school, I was an Account Manager at Kite & Lantern Agency, where I managed campaigns for three snack brands. I'm now aiming for Associate Brand Manager roles in CPG, and I'd love to hear how you showed brand-side employers that your agency experience was relevant.

Would you have 20 minutes for a coffee chat in the coming weeks? I'm happy to work around your schedule.

Thank you,
Elena Ruiz
questions: When you interviewed for the Associate Brand Manager role at Bright Meadow Foods, how did you frame your creative agency experience so it felt relevant to the brand side?
Which skills from your two years at a creative agency turned out to matter most once you were managing the granola line?
What advice would you give me as I position my agency work on three snack brands for Associate Brand Manager recruiting in CPG?
What did you need to demonstrate as an Associate Brand Manager to earn your promotion to Brand Manager on the granola line?
Since I hope to own a food brand's P&L someday, what does managing the business side of the granola line look like in your Brand Manager role?

I'm Elena, an MBA candidate in the Class of 2028. Before business school, I was an Account Manager at Kite & Lantern Agency, where I managed campaigns for three snack brands and grew one client's social engagement by 45%.
Food brands have always felt personal to me,
since I grew up cooking with my grandmother.
. I could talk to shoppers all day!

I'm so excited about that next chapter!
Since you made the move from a creative agency to Bright Meadow Foods, I'd love to learn how you showed brand-side employers that your agency experience was relevant.

tmay_2min.text: Thank you for taking the time to chat with me, Hannah. My classmate introduced us,
and I'm so glad they did!

A little about me: I'm Elena, an MBA candidate in the Class of 2028, and I studied Communications in undergrad. From 2020 to 2026, I was an Account Manager at Kite & Lantern Agency, where I managed campaigns for three snack brands.
One highlight I'm really proud of is that
I grew one client's social engagement by 45%. Outside of work, I also volunteered on a food bank marketing committee from 2022 to 2025.
Food is a big part of who I am.
I grew up cooking with my grandmother,
I care so much about food brands. I also love consumer research interviews.
Hearing what people actually think about the food they buy is genuinely one of my favorite things!
All of that is pointing me toward
my next step: moving from the agency side to the brand side. I'm targeting Associate Brand Manager roles at consumer packaged goods companies, and someday I want to own a food brand's P&L.
I've had a blast supporting brands from the agency seat, and I'm excited to get closer to the decisions and the business itself.
That's why your path really stood out to me.
You spent two years at a creative agency, joined Bright Meadow Foods as an Associate Brand Manager, and were promoted to Brand Manager on the granola line.
That's exactly the kind of journey I'm hoping for!
I'd especially love to learn how you showed brand-side employers that your agency experience was relevant.
